posts.title: Male Sexuality
posts.description: The male sexuality is necrophiliac. It makes love to the dead, the static, the passive. The whole Parthenon of male affection is reduced to nothing but bodies, corpses, carcass. Ed Gein was an honest male. Where other men objectified in the mind, he objectified materially. Women reduced to chairs, lamp shades and nipple belts. Woman is reduced to nothing more than furniture. posts.title: Artless Australia
posts.description: Colonial Australia cannot produce art. It has never known art, because it has never had culture to begin with. Culture is the necessary material for creating a work of art, something developed from a collective striving toward achievement, and Australia has never strove toward anything, much less achieved anything. posts.title: A Review on Method (So Far)
posts.description: Art must take place outside of galleries, and away from those who place a hold on aesthetics (Like critics, connoisseurs or ‘cultured’ people). Locations of ordinary life – city streets, bus stops, building walls – are all apt locations for works of art. The internet is a democratic space (for the most part).
